title: Block Out Level 14 Walkthrough
summary: Open the white ladder and reduce the top counter before releasing the large cyan centerpiece from its surrounding frame.

boardProfile.layout: A large cyan counter tile fills the center of a five-color frame, with white pieces concentrated above and to the right and yellow columns holding the side lanes.
landmarks: The center is a large cyan square marked 7.
A top counter begins at 17 above the central frame.
White pillars form a ladder on the right side.
Yellow columns sit on both sides while black pieces anchor the lower corners.

quickTips: Work the right-side white lane before spending the bottom yellow exit.
Leave the cyan 7 in place until the frame has opened on more than one side.
Judge each clear by the next lane it creates, not only by the block removed now.

steps.title: Loosen the right edge
steps.instruction: Move the upper-right white pieces into their available exit lane so the outer frame begins to shrink.

steps.title: Reduce the top counter
steps.instruction: Continue clearing the top structure while keeping the cyan 7 fixed in the center.

steps.title: Preserve the side supports
steps.instruction: Use the yellow side columns to keep space available while the lower black pieces are repositioned.

steps.title: Create vertical room
steps.instruction: After the right ladder is thinner, bring a white pillar down to open the first vertical lane beside the centerpiece.

steps.title: Release the centerpiece
steps.instruction: Move the cyan 7 only when the frame is open on at least two sides, then clear the remaining white and black pieces.

steps.title: Use the yellow exit last
steps.instruction: Finish through the bottom yellow exit after the central block and the remaining frame pieces are no longer competing for space.

failurePoints: Trying to move the cyan 7 while the right ladder still locks the frame.
Clearing the bottom yellow lane too early and removing the spacing needed for the middle phase.

seo.title: Block Out Level 14 Walkthrough and Solution
seo.description: Match the cyan 7 board, open the right ladder, reduce the top counter and follow the complete Block Out Level 14 solution.
